scientific_queries.note: Self-demanded replication of R99's refutation across three pools and two criteria.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round carries out the replication its own predecessor required, and the refutation fails to replicate.

honest_reconciliation.R99: 80 splits x 10 blocks gave +5.37 [-2.94 is not right: 2.94, 7.81], significant
honest_reconciliation.R100: 30 splits x 6 blocks gives +3.50 [-0.50, 7.50] on the same pool, not significant
honest_reconciliation.contradiction: no - the point estimates are compatible and R100's interval is about twice as wide because it has less than half the power
honest_reconciliation.but: the replication I demanded of myself did not confirm, so the word 'refuted' was premature and is withdrawn

signal_that_survives: all six contrasts have positive point estimates, a weak 6/6 pattern, but they are not independent and only the highest-powered run reached significance
the_recurring_error: R93 evaluated on a subset that excluded the penalty; R94 compared across different masks; R99 declared a refutation on one high-powered run whose replication then failed. The common fault is treating 'what happened under one set of parameters' as 'what is established'.
limits: R100 has under half of R99's power, so its non-significance is substantially a power problem
the three pools share one training set and are not independent
the both-unseen pool holds only about 1,830 keys
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: run R99's full power (80 splits x 10 blocks) across all three pools and both criteria, about 2.7 times this round's cost
